as_told.title: UFOs near Fukushima and a UFO museum

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a story from Vice, a news outlet, about a small town in Japan next to Fukushima, where an earthquake set off a nuclear power plant meltdown in 2011, whose people are devoted to UFOs. He quotes the chief monk of a local temple saying so many UFOs came after the explosion that he was shocked, and in other tellings he mentions a UFO museum, a nearby mountain dedicated to UFOs, and a local belief that the UFOs helped clean up the spill. Michels tells it as one more sign that UFOs show up around nuclear sites.
